description: Florida motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A Florida rider who is age 21 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Florida age rule is aimed at riders 20 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: Before Florida adds a motorcycle endorsement, a new rider must
options: Hold a learner permit for six months
Pass a road test at the DMV only
questions.explanation: Florida law (s. 322.12(5)(a)) requires new riders to complete the Basic RiderCourse (or BRCu) with an authorized sponsor. Florida has no motorcycle learner permit.

questions.q: After passing the Basic RiderCourse in Florida, you must get the endorsement within
questions.explanation: The course completion is valid for one year. After that you must take the course again.

questions.q: A Florida rider 21 or older may ride without a helmet only if they
options: Carry at least $10,000 of medical benefits insurance
Ride only on roads posted at 45 mph or below
Have held a motorcycle endorsement for five years
Have completed an advanced rider course this year
questions.explanation: Section 316.211 lets a rider 21 or older ride without a helmet only while covered by an insurance policy with at least $10,000 in medical benefits for crash injuries.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Florida?

provenance.manual: Florida Class E Driver License Handbook 2023

questions.q: What does Florida law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Florida: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: Florida Class E Driver License Handbook 2023

questions.q: What does Florida require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Florida: eye protection is required for all riders.

provenance.manual: Florida Class E Driver License Handbook 2023
